 ATP Paris Day 4 Predictions Including Taylor Fritz vs Arthur Fils 
 Share Share this article
 × X Facebook LinkedIn WhatsApp Reddit Email Copy 
 With Novak Djokovic, Alexander Zverev, Daniil Medvedev, Holger Rune, and Karen Khachanov already eliminated from ATP Paris, and Jannik Sinner not participating, we are guaranteed a new Paris champion this year , which will add plenty of intrigue as we head into the decisive stages of the tournament. This Thursday will feature all of the last 16 matches and is sure to be an incredible day of tennis in the French capital. But who will advance?
 ATP Paris Day 4 Predictions
 Tommy Paul vs Quentin Halys
 Head-to-head: Paul 1-1 Halys
 Paul needs at least a final this week to reach Turin , but he’s been playing at a level that lets him dream of it. He has already won more matches (48) this year than in any other year and will be looking to end 2026 in glory. While Halys got a fantastic win over Tiafoe today, the latter has been disappointing since the US Open, with Paul clearly playing at a higher level.
 Prediction: Paul in 2 
 Ben Shelton vs Arthur Rinderknech
 Head-to-head: Rinderknech 1-0 Shelton
 Rinderknech has had a disappointing season after a breakthrough 2025, but a deep run could easily change that. Given Shelton’s struggles since the US Open, this is not a bad draw for the Frenchman, even if Shelton looked better than he has recently against Cameron Norrie in his first match. Rinderknech definitely has a real chance at ATP Paris, especially if he can feed off the home crowd.
 Prediction: Rinderknech in 3 
 Jan-Lennard Struff vs Casper Ruud
 Head-to-head: Struff 4-1 Ruud
 Struff has been playing amazing tennis in recent weeks, following a final in Brussels with a semifinal in Basel (where he even had a match point) and now another good run at ATP Paris. He has already secured a top 40 finish, but he will certainly believe he can do even more given the level he has been showing.
 However, Ruud himself, after a rough season aside from the Rome final, has been somewhat turning things around after the US Open, reaching the quarterfinals in Shanghai and now putting together another good run here. If Struff serves well, he could definitely win, but all things considered, it should be a very close match decided by small details, with Ruud having the slight edge as the more solid player overall.
 Prediction: Ruud in 3 
 Taylor Fritz vs Arthur Fils
 Head-to-head: Fritz 1-1 Fils
 Fritz needs a win to keep his Turin hopes alive, and he has been serving incredibly this week so far, with 57 aces in his first two matches. When the pair faced each other last week, Fils retired due to injury, but he already seems to have recovered and played well against Tomas Machac in his first match. That said, Fritz should be more desperate and willing to put his body on the line for a win at ATP Paris, which might ultimately make the difference.
 Prediction: Fritz in 3
